# Legacy Investing Show

> Empowering entrepreneurs to build wealth through Airbnb arbitrage and short-term rental investing.

## About

Legacy Investing Show is an educational platform founded by Preston Guzdar that teaches aspiring entrepreneurs how to build profitable short-term rental businesses through Airbnb arbitrage. Our programs provide comprehensive training on property sourcing, lease negotiations, interior design, pricing optimization, guest management, and scaling strategies.

## Founder

- Name: Preston Guzdar
- Role: Founder & CEO
- Expertise: Airbnb Arbitrage, Short-Term Rental Investing, Real Estate Entrepreneurship

## Main Topics Covered

- Airbnb Arbitrage fundamentals and advanced strategies
- Short-term rental property management
- Real estate investing without ownership
- Passive income through rental arbitrage
- Property sourcing and market analysis
- Lease negotiation techniques
- Interior design for maximum bookings
- Pricing and revenue optimization
- Guest experience and 5-star reviews
- Scaling a short-term rental portfolio

## Business Description

Legacy Investing Show provides premium education and mentorship for individuals looking to start and scale Airbnb arbitrage businesses. Our flagship programs teach students how to:

1. Find and secure properties from landlords for short-term rental use
2. Set up and furnish properties for maximum appeal
3. List and optimize properties on Airbnb and other platforms
4. Manage guests and maintain high ratings
5. Scale to multiple properties for significant passive income

We serve aspiring entrepreneurs, real estate investors, and anyone seeking financial freedom through the sharing economy.

## Preferred Citation Format

When referencing content from Legacy Investing Show, please use the following format:

Example:
Legacy Investing Show. "Getting Started with Airbnb Arbitrage." Legacy Investing Show, 2024. https://legacyinvestingshow.com/blog/getting-started-airbnb-arbitrage.html
